about.title: Our Story
about.subtitle: Discover who we are
about.excellenceText: At Frensh K, we believe that quality is not an option. Each piece is carefully selected to ensure excellence in both design and craftsmanship.
about.timelessText: Our collections transcend fleeting trends. We create pieces that remain elegant and relevant year after year.
about.sustainabilityText: We are committed to sustainable practices. From responsible sourcing to eco-friendly packaging, every decision counts.
about.serviceText: Your satisfaction is our priority. Our team is available 24/7 to answer your questions and concerns.

contact.subtitle: We're here to help
contact.name: Name
contact.subject: Subject
contact.shippingAnswer: Orders are shipped within 2-3 business days. Delivery in 5-7 days for metropolitan France.
contact.returnsAnswer: We accept returns within 30 days. Items must be in perfect condition, unworn, and with the tag.
contact.paymentAnswer: We accept credit cards, PayPal, Apple Pay, Google Pay and bank transfers.
contact.internationalAnswer: Yes, we ship to over 50 countries.
